label: Under A2c's denial of necessary universal coverage by chains lacking a first member and outside…
paraphrase: Under A2c's denial of necessary universal coverage by chains lacking a first member and outside causes together with its entire-chain conditions, a cause-capable head of an entire chain is possible and hence a cause-capable uncaused thing is possible. This is the source's disputed conditional, not a certified derivation; its cause-capable domain differs from A2P1 and a graph source alone need not be a relational head.
